activation.note: Activation covers feature and manifest work, including review of existing violations and content-only changes, without exempting compliant features from the invariant. Repository-wide orphan and duplicate detection is honestly labeled needs_new_observer; local paths, operations and task terms are directly observable.

audit.summary: Every source segment survives at a claimed destination, including the exact-one registration obligation, manifest definition and provenance metadata. Additional workflow preferences and verification guidance are declared, no exceptions are introduced, and no content is diverted to shared nodes.

segmentChecks.note: The original name is retained verbatim in audit; the imperative title also accurately restates it.
The exact-one-wagon registration obligation is stated directly in then and reinforced by the orphan/duplicate prohibitions and evidence.
All legacy provenance fields and values survive in audit.
Severity 2 is retained in verifier_detail and audit.
The documentation-only disposition is retained in verifier_detail and audit.
The complete parity record is retained in audit, with the implementation status also usefully surfaced in verifier_detail.
The wagon_manifest term identifier is explicit in verifier_detail and its concept is defined in given.
The definition of the wagon manifest is preserved essentially verbatim in both given and verifier_detail.

risks: If a target manifest has no existing entries, its entry syntax remains unspecified; the coder must obtain that repository-specific convention elsewhere. The source also supplies no schema, and the rewrite correctly avoids inventing one.

unobservable: finding=feature_unregistered or feature_registered_in_multiple_wagons is not observable until the declared repository-wide feature-id/manifest cross-reference observer exists.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the exact-one-wagon invariant, manifest definition, and metadata while adding direct, non-exception workflow guidance. A weak planner can determine the required create, move, remove, and assessment behavior from the coder-facing fields; only entry syntax remains repository-dependent. I agree with the auditor's PASS, with global orphan/duplicate findings correctly marked as requiring a new observer.
